attendance_policy: There is no marks for class attendance. Attending classes would certainly make difference in learning & marks would reflect the same.
makeup_policy: Make-up request for the mid-semester examination is to be submitted 7 days in advance of the exam (or within 72 hrs. in case of medical emergency). For comprehensive examination the request is often made to AUGSD. It is mandatory to submit the necessary supporting documents (such as: listed below) along with make-up request: o Letter of invitation/selection for a national/international event where the applicant is representing BITS Pilani. o Proof of hospitalization, medical certificate, prescription, medicine purchase bill, etc. There is no makeup for the project presentations. However, students can mutually change the dates with permission from I/C.
